types.description:
Widely accepted regional models, or models of similar depositional systems.
Analogues and standard geological models are broader than the field-specific static reservoir models. Standard models are often produced by universities and reflect the consensus geological view of the depositional environment in question. Analogues are models from different areas with similar depositional environments to the one in question - they can come from anywhere in the world - and are used for comparison purposes.
types.name: GEOLOGY.AnaloguesAndStandardGeologicalModels

types.description: Borehole breakouts are hole enlargements (whilst drilling) caused by horizontal stresses in the rock formation. The hole becomes more oval than round. Analysis is carried out to determine the extent of the breakout and to plan how to continue the safe drilling of the hole. Often dealing with mud weight issues, borehole stress calculations,and analysis of caliper logs (which tell the shape of the borehole)
types.name: GEOLOGY.BoreholeBreakoutAnalysis

types.description: Report which interprets borehole image logs. Tool names can include Formation MicroImager (FMI), Ultrasonic Imaging Tool (USIT), Ultrasonic Borehole Imager (UBI), Acoustic borehole image (borehole televiewer),Electrical MicroImager (EMI). In open-hole, these are used to identify fractures, breakouts and other borehole features. In cased hole, they are used to identify internal corrosion. Report will generally show detailed analysis of a section or sections of interest along the well.OR - Report from logging contractor/processing company detailing the processing undertaken to create a borehole image from raw measurements. May also include some basic interpretation
types.name: GEOLOGY.BoreholeImageAnalysis

types.description: Geological description of the slabbed core including lithology, hydrocarbon shows, palaeontological indices and environments and key stratal surfaces. No analysis, no interpretation, no experiments

types.description: Reports detailing the acquisition aspect of a coring operation. May also include sidewall samples aquired using wireline methods. types.description: Proposal to core a well/sidetrack. Programme of operations to perform coring.  Supplemental information to guide, on requirements of the coring acquisition. types.description:
Documents which extrapolate data from individual wells and seismic to create and overall model of the field
Will contain a diagram of a vertical section through a field, as opposed to the surface, bird's eye or plan view of a map. Cross sections are useful for displaying the types and orientations of subsurface structures and formations. Will often be concerned with the connectivity between the various reservoir units. Will contain Correlation Panels (charts showing a number of wells side by side, and attempting to interpret the geology ofthe area between the wells.
types.name: GEOLOGY.FieldCorrelationReportAndCrossSection
